result.title: DynOLAT: OLAT Video Prediction for Controllable Dynamic Full-Body Relighting
result.comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 (Journal Track). Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/DynOLAT
result.summary: Accurate lighting response is essential for realistic dynamic human relighting, because shadows, highlights, and color changes should follow the target illumination in both direction and relative strength. Current learning-based relighting methods can generate visually plausible videos, but they often exhibit imprecise lighting responses: shadows and highlights may drift away from the target direction, and the output brightness may not faithfully follow the relative intensities in the target environment, making the result closer to appearance harmonization than controllable relighting. To address this issue, we propose DynOLAT, a generalizable OLAT video prediction framework for dynamic full-body humans. Instead of directly synthesizing a single relit appearance, our method predicts temporally consistent One-Light-At-a-Time (OLAT) basis videos from flat-lit inputs, and then linearly combines the predicted bases according to the target environment map. This OLAT-based formulation makes the directional response explicit in the predicted bases, while the relative lighting strength is determined by the linear weights derived from the environment map. We further introduce a dynamic capture pipeline and the first large-scale dynamic full-body OLAT dataset, comprising over 24 million frames from 224 identity-outfit combinations, where different outfits of the same person define separate combinations. Experiments show that DynOLAT responds more faithfully to variations in target lighting direction and relative intensity than the tested baselines, enabling controllable video relighting while preserving fine appearance details and temporal coherence. The dataset and processing tools will be publicly released to foster future research.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DynOLAT：从均匀光照视频预测时序一致的 OLAT 基视频，再按目标环境图权重线性组合实现可控人体重光照，并发布大规模动态全身 OLAT 数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作研究物理光照响应与视频时间一致性，「基分解＋权重组合」仅是渲染层面的显式分解，不涉及视觉推理内部状态、证据筛选、动态计算或停止决策，与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的具体联系。
